summary: Two Palestinians were injured in two separate incidents when settlers threw stones at Palestinian vehicles.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; PLO NAD Daily Situation Report 20 Mar 2023; WAFA 20 Mar 2023; PLO NAD Daily Situation Report 27 Mar 2023; PLO NAD March 2023 monthly report
resolution_notes: Unresolved-first recheck confirms the Mar.19 Al-Maarajat component is already canonical as ILPV-2023-0323. For Deir Istiya, Mar.26 remains the best-supported event date: NAD's March monthly report explicitly dates it Mar.26, while the Mar.27 daily report records the incident at 13:50 and identifies the injured civilian as Muhammad Sami Muhammad Abu Rabi', a Balata camp resident, who was admitted to the government hospital in Nablus. Exact-name Arabic/English searches found no independent exact-event corroboration or original media. OCHA's aggregate date treatment remains preserved as a discrepancy; the Deir Istiya component stays Unresolved rather than accepted by inference.
media_status: No exact/original visual media recovered for the unresolved Deir Istiya component; no generic imagery used.
